request: Build a small Jac web app for envelope budgeting by month. Income goes into a 'to budget' pool; the user assigns amounts to categories each month and records spending against them. A category's available amount is what was budgeted plus last month's leftover minus spending. Overspending is not carried as a negative: it is taken from next month's 'to budget' instead.
acceptance: A category budgeted 100 with 30 spent in January starts February with 70 available.
A category overspent by 20 in January starts February at 0, and February's 'to budget' is 20 lower.
Budgeting more than 'to budget' is allowed but makes it negative, and the month is flagged as overbudgeted.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.
